targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, symbol AS metric, vwap AS value FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY window_start
SELECT symbol, ROUND(AVG(vwap)::numeric, 2) as avg_vwap, SUM(trade_count) as trades FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY symbol
SELECT symbol, ROUND(SUM(total_volume)::numeric, 0) as volume FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY volume DESC
SELECT window_start AS time, symbol AS metric, trade_count AS value FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY window_start
SELECT window_start AS time, 'High' AS metric, max_price AS value FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND symbol = 'POWER_DE' ORDER BY window_start
SELECT window_start AS time, 'Low' AS metric, min_price AS value FROM trade_aggregates WHERE window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND symbol = 'POWER_DE' ORDER BY window_start
